text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Victory in the Tenno Sho (Autumn). 
Celebrated by her peers, Seiun Sky 
promises a rematch with Special Week at 
the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, after the race, an injury is 
discovered on Seiun Sky's leg. 
Fortunately, it is minor, but the doctor 
recommends she rest for the remainder of 
the year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky made a rare impassioned plea to 
enter the Arima Kinen. Her desire for 
victory, swollen beyond all hurdles, could 
no longer be disguised.
